# ScopeWise MITRE ATT&CK Coverage — honest view
---
Your detection coverage against **MITRE ATT&CK v19.1** (697 enterprise techniques and sub-techniques), computed from the analytics rules actually running in this workspace.

How this differs from the built-in MITRE blade:

- **Enabled rules only** — a disabled rule is a gap, not coverage.
- **Alert-fired evidence** — rules that never produced an alert in the lookback window are flagged (Rule health tab).
- **No simulated inflation** — rule templates you haven't deployed don't count.
- **Telemetry reality check** — techniques whose required log tables aren't being ingested (Telemetry tab).
- **Current ATT&CK v19.1** — the blade tracks an older framework version.

Viewer needs the **Microsoft Sentinel Reader** role. Nothing leaves your tenant — every query runs with your own permissions.

| sort by ['Alerts in window'] asc
